action.rationale: Fresh 10D problem with budget 2000, cheap deterministic evaluations, and no incumbent or progress yet. Per the probing rule, spending ~12% (~240/2000) to characterize basins and smoothness will guide method choice and warm-start from real data.

Probes indicate a smooth near-quadratic landscape (r2_quad_full=0.9658) and L-BFGS-B already gave large gains (median rel_gain=0.9379) reaching 3179.64 in 32 evals per start. With deterministic, cheap evaluations and 64 stall_evals since the probe, a focused L-BFGS-B polish from the incumbent should rapidly converge further.

Probes indicate a smooth, near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.9658), and L-BFGS-B just delivered large gains (improvement_in_tenure=2956.25) with no exhaustion flagged. With stall_evals=1 and the active method still progressing, another round of L-BFGS-B is the most efficient next step.

Probes indicate a near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.9658), while L-BFGS-B has slowed (best improved only from 223.393 to 219.992 over the last 100 evals; stall_evals=11). Switching to BOBYQA for local trust-region refinement may handle scaling better (P5 large grad norms 2.0e5–4.8e5) and squeeze further gains from the current basin.

BOBYQA just cut the best from 219.992 to 155.155 over 200 evals and is not exhausted (stall_evals=0, exhausted=false). Probes indicate a smooth near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.9658), so another round of BOBYQA should continue yielding efficient local gains.

Probes indicate a near-quadratic, smooth landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.9658) and L-BFGS-B performed strongly in probing (median rel_gain=0.9379). Bobyqa is still improving but slowly (best 155.155→152.958 last round; 67.03 improvement over 300 evals), so a gradient-based polish from the new incumbent should accelerate progress. Deterministic, cheap evaluations favor an L-BFGS-B polish now.

The landscape appears near-quadratic (P3 r2_quad_full=0.9658) and LBFGSB is our top performer (best 150.294 vs BOBYQA 152.958). The active LBFGSB instance is not exhausted and delivered 2.664 improvement over its last 200 evals with only 1 stall_eval, so another short run should yield smaller but tangible gains.

Probes suggest a near-quadratic, smooth landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.9658), and L-BFGS-B is not exhausted and still improving (best 150.474→149.361 by eval 1138; stall_evals=2). Continuing this local solver should yield further decrease efficiently in this 10D deterministic, cheap setting.

Landscape evidence is near-quadratic and smooth (P3 r2_quad_full=0.9658; P5 cosine=1.0), and L-BFGS-B is still making progress with stall_evals=3 and 3.80 improvement over its 400-eval tenure. The best has tightened to 149.1566, improving steadily from 150.819→149.45→149.157 in recent rounds, so another round of line searches should yield incremental gains.

L-BFGS-B has effectively stalled (stall_evals=15, best improved only from 149.175 to 149.15 over the last ~120 evals), while probes indicate a smooth near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.9658). BOBYQA is well-suited for local quadratic refinement and may squeeze further gains from the current incumbent with a modest budget.

Local solvers have clearly stalled: bobyqa improved only 2.09e-08 over its last 200 evals and stall_evals is 215, with both lbfgsb and bobyqa stuck at 149.15. With 462 evals left, a small race between CMA-ES and TuRBO hedges exploration versus exploitation on this near-quadratic (P3 r2_quad_full=0.9658) landscape while leaving budget for a final polish.

We have only 162 evals left and have stalled for 515 evals at 149.15, so the remaining budget is best spent on local refinement. Probes indicate a near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.9658), while CMA-ES shows an extremely small sigma (2.7e-06) and no improvement, suggesting it’s effectively stagnant. BOBYQA previously achieved the incumbent (149.15) and is suitable for tight polishing from the incumbent.

Only 105 evaluations remain and the active bobyqa is exhausted while we’ve stalled for 572 evals at 149.15. Probes indicate a smooth, nearly quadratic landscape (r2_quad_full=0.9658; P5 cosine=1.0), so a final L-BFGS-B polish from the incumbent is our best chance for a small improvement.

LBFGSB is exhausted (exhausted=true after 33 evals in tenure) and we have stalled for 605 evals at y=149.15, with only 72 evaluations left. A final derivative-free local polish from the incumbent gives a last low-risk chance to squeeze small gains when gradients have plateaued. Prior CMA-ES and BOBYQA did not beat 149.15, so NM is the remaining local alternative.

Only 61 evals remain out of 2000, and we've been stalled for 616 evals at y=149.15. Multiple polishers (lbfgsb 833 evals, bobyqa 557, nelder_mead exhausted) and CMA-ES race all converged to the same best 149.15, so further improvement within 61 evals is unlikely.
